cases.doc: src/05-nodejs.md l.25, l.38 (Node 20: no setting adds PQ)
cases.finding: AL2023 dnf nodejs20 (20.20.2) links the system OpenSSL 3.5.8, so it negotiates X25519MLKEM768 once the crypto policy is DEFAULT:PQ or OPENSSL_CONF points at openssl-pq-node-system.cnf, exactly like nodejs22/24. The tab says the opposite: src/05-nodejs.md l.25 ('20.x ... No / No / No ... Upgrade; no setting adds PQ'), l.38 ('any Node below 22.20 / 24.5: upgrade ... There is no setting') and l.5 ('anything on Node 20 or older'). l.452 already notes this for Debian 13's Node 20; the l.26 AL2023 row should cover nodejs20 too, and the rule should be 'check process.versions.openssl'.
